title: T40 normalized authorized reminder query; SOURCE_ONLY_NOT_MOUNTED
x-runtime-constraints: HTTP omitted fields normalize to after_event_id null, cursor null, limit50 and baseline_token null; reject unknown or duplicate parameters
only an initial all-null window returns an empty baseline plus its bounded opaque baseline_token

live reads require the token to bind the original principal, effective authorization revision, source-fact cutoff, after/as-of ID floor and ten-minute expiry; current READ is still independently required
cursor binds that token, principal, effective authorization revision, after/as-of IDs and limit; it cannot change the query
initial/recovery or stale/mismatched token is not historical playback authority; a verified current scope can establish a new empty baseline
all decimal IDs are at most 9223372036854775807; do not convert them to JS Number
